Ceramic & Graphene Protection ⏱ Duration: ~360 minutes

9H Graphene Ceramic Coating Shield

The pinnacle of automotive paint protection. Graphene-infused ceramic forms a permanent crystalline covalent bond with your vehicle clear coat. Rated at 9H pencil hardness, it provides unmatched hydrophobic water-beading, UV shielding against Jammu sun, anti-corrosion defense, and deep candy gloss for up to 3 years.

Explore Service
The Problem It Solves

Environmental etching, bird dropping stains, UV oxidation, fading paint, and difficult cleaning.

Who It's For

New vehicles and corrected cars seeking long-term preservation of paint value and ease of maintenance.

Step-by-step treatment process

How our trained technicians execute this service in our dedicated bay.

1

Full Paint Prep & Correction

Perfecting the clear coat to 90%+ defect-free state before locking it in.

2

Alcohol Panel Wipe

Removing all polishing oils for optimal ceramic molecular bonding.

3

Dual-Layer Ceramic Application

Cross-hatch precision application of base coat and graphene top coat.

4

Infrared Curing & Inspection

Thermal curing ensuring maximum cross-link density and hardness.

Common questions about this treatment.

Our 9H Graphene Ceramic Coating provides 3 to 5 years of verified protection when maintained with recommended washes.
Ceramic coating protects against chemical stains, swirls, oxidation and light scratches. For high-speed gravel protection, Paint Protection Film (PPF) is recommended.
